name: Miami University
oos_note: Public university. Non-resident tuition & fees for most recent published cohort (2027, entered 26-27): tuition $15,616 + fees $3,454 + non-resident surcharge $24,228 = $43,298 annually. Source: Miami University One Stop Cost of Attendance by Cohort page (miamioh.edu/onestop/costs/coa-by-cohort.html). Excludes room/board/housing.
